4ESTSEC/wxvl.body:
# WeChat Official Account Security Vulnerability Article Archive

This project extends [original wxvl](https://github.com/20142995/wxvl) and adds security vulnerability articles published between April 2022 and April 2025.

## ✨ Project Features

Automatically crawls security vulnerability articles from WeChat Official Accounts, converts them to Markdown format, and builds a local knowledge base, updated continuously every day.

## 📰 Data Sources

Data comes from Official Account articles from the following channels:
- [chainreactors/picker](https://github.com/chainreactors/picker) daily archive
- [BruceFeIix/picker](https://github.com/BruceFeIix/picker) daily archive
- [Doonsec](https://doonsec.com) RSS feed
- Official Account links extracted from GitHub Issues

## 🔍 Content Filtering Rules

The system automatically identifies articles that contain the following keywords:
复现|漏洞|CVE-\d+|CNVD-\d+|CNNVD-\d+|XVE-\d+|QVD-\d+|POC|EXP|0day|1day|nday|RCE|代码执行|命令执行

## 🛠️ Technical Implementation

- Uses [wechatmp2markdown](https://github.com/fengxxc/wechatmp2markdown) to convert Official Account articles to Markdown format
- Intelligently handles special characters to generate compliant file names
- Stores files by year and month: `doc/yy-mm/`
- Records processed links in `data.json` to avoid duplicates

## ⚙️ Usage

### Automatic Run
- GitHub Actions runs automatically every 4 hours

### Manual Run
```bash
# Fetch today's new articles
python run.py today

# Fetch historical articles (use after modifying the script)
python run_history.py history

BMingSY/isaac-lan.body:
# Isaac LAN

LAN co-op extension for The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+, supporting 2–4 players, for the Windows version **v1.9.7.17.J460**.

## Features

- Shared floors: explore and fight in split rooms, and join teammates' rooms at any time to regroup.
- Allows loading other mods, while keeping the original multiplayer UI and the official online entry point.
- The minimap shows player positions, supports ping display, and reconnects after disconnects.

## Installation

1. Extract the full installation package and run `Install.cmd`.
2. Keep the game closed, then select `isaac-ng.exe` in the game directory.
3. Launch the game normally from Steam, select a save slot, and go to **Online → LAN Co-op**.

All players must use the same game version and the same LAN co-op extension.

### Linux／Steam Deck (Proton)

Requires the Windows version J460 and Proton 11.0-2 or later.

Set `ISAAC_GAME_DIRECTORY` to the game's install location, then run:

```sh
python3 install.py --game-directory "$ISAAC_GAME_DIRECTORY"
```

Set the Steam launch option to:

```text
WINEDLLOVERRIDES="winmm=n,b" %command%
```

When upgrading, run the install command again from the new package. To uninstall, use the same command with `--mode Uninstall` and remove the launch option above. Configuration, co-op saves, and historical logs are kept.

## Configuration and Logs

On first launch, `isaac-lan/config.ini` is generated in the game directory:

```ini
; Isaac LAN: restart the game after changes take effect.
[network]
; Guest input send rate: 30 / 60, default 60; each client may differ.
; 30 reduces input traffic but may add one rendered frame of delay; host simulation and local display rate are unchanged.
input_hz = 60

[logging]
; Logs are stored in the same game data directory as the original log.txt, in folders organized by launch and session.
; startup.log records startup and exit; runtime.log records in-game events.
; Historical logs can be cleaned up manually.
; Log level: DEBUG / INFO / WARN / ERROR, default INFO.
level = INFO

[diagnostics]
; Performance statistics: true / false, default false; enable when troubleshooting stutter.
; When enabled, performance.jsonl is generated in the same log directory.
performance = false
; Performance sampling interval (milliseconds): 100–60000, default 1000.
sample_interval_ms = 1000

[chat]
; Chat background opacity: 0–100, 0 fully transparent, 100 opaque. …
```

> 
> GitHub releases include three APKs, for arm64, x86_64, and universal builds. Choose as needed (usually arm64);

> For trying out features still in development. The APK is updated with every code push and does not represent the final stable release.

- Image captcha recognition model (downloaded within the app, located under [Options - Preferences & Configuration - Automatic Image Captcha Filling])
> To reduce the APK size, the captcha recognition model (about 11MB) is split out and available as an optional download;
- Guest experience data pack (downloaded within the app, located under [Options - Preferences & Configuration - Backup & Restore])
> So that other developers can also try the app, a guest data pack is provided. Importing it unlocks more features, but not all features are available. If you need it, contact the developer.

## Introduction
An Android campus-services aggregator app developed for undergraduate students at Hefei University of Technology (HFUT), covering 40+ scenarios and features across teaching, daily life, and on-campus services, with support for offline use. Built with a modern tech stack, it offers a comprehensive, clean, and efficient user experience.

Interface showcase (v4.20.1.3; the latest version takes precedence):

Interface: uses shaders, real-time blur, and other effects, integrated with Material Design 3, simple and efficient

Motion: a self-developed second-generation global transition animation system, with intuitive, one-take-style motion

Updates: 250+ version iterations, with at least one update on average per week, bringing new features, refactors, and optimizations

Performance: fast cold start, with key information shown right at launch; moderate memory and storage usage

### Requirements
Android 8.0 (SDK 26+) or later, with internet access
### First Use
With internet access, enter your student ID and information portal password, log in, and wait for loading to complete (the bottom bar changes from dim to normal). Then you can use the app

After logging in, the required data is fetched and cached automatically (e.g., the timetable academic source, course summaries, etc.). Due to platform restrictions, some platforms do not support persistent login, so expired platform data is selectively refreshed at login

The app automatically checks for updates at startup. If an update is available, a red dot appears on the 'Options' tab in the bottom bar on the home page, and the options screen shows a download prompt. After downloading, tap to install and grant permission to install unknown apps.

A mobile reader **for Android only**. Catalog and sync come from [INPX Library Server](https://github.com/Habsaec/inpx-library-server); book text is read only from the downloaded file on the device.

## What this is

| Need | How it works |
| --- | --- |
| Catalog, search, shelves, profile | Server's REST `/api/*` |
| Reading FB2 / EPUB | Local file via Foliate |
| Position, bookmarks, notes | Sync by `bookId` |
| iOS / Desktop / PWA | Not supported |

**Without a running INPX Library Server, the app is nearly useless** (no catalog, downloads, or sync). The server is the source of truth for metadata; the file path on disk is a snapshot taken at download time, not a sync field.

## Requirements

1. **[INPX Library Server](https://github.com/Habsaec/inpx-library-server)** already installed and running (default port `3000`)
2. **Node.js 20+**
3. **Android Studio** (SDK API 34+, Build-Tools, Platform-Tools) and **JDK 17**
4. Phone and server on the **same Wi‑Fi network** (for the APK, the server address must be the IP of the PC/NAS, not `localhost`)

The APK build below is designed for **Windows** (`gradlew.bat`). Details and troubleshooting: [`docs/ANDROID.md`](https://github.com/Habsaec/inpx-book-reader/blob/HEAD/docs/ANDROID.md).

# 宝宝记录与工具箱

Baby Records & Toolbox

# Baby Records & Toolbox

A local-first mini-program built with uni-app + Vue 3 + Vite: baby tracking plus everyday calculation tools. All data and calculations are done on the device, with no backend dependency.

## Features

### Baby (Tab)

- Baby profile: nickname, date of birth, gender, and age in months
- Daily records: feeding, sleep, and diaper changes, with today's statistics
- Growth chart: height and weight records with canvas line charts
- Vaccine reference: Category 1 / Category 2 reference lists, vaccination checkmarks, custom vaccines
- Growth journal: milestones, daily mood, parenting notes
- Data management: JSON export / restore / clear

### Tools (Tab)

- VAT calculator: bidirectional conversion between tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive amounts, with common and custom tax rates
- Unit conversion: length, weight, temperature, storage, area
- Text processing: line-based deduplication, case conversion
- Base conversion: bases 2–36, supports negative numbers and very large integers

The floating button in the lower-right corner of the Tools page opens the "All Tools" drawer, which shows VAT by default.

## Running

```bash
yarn install

# WeChat mini-program development
yarn dev:mp-weixin

# H5 development (local debugging only)
yarn dev:h5

# Unit tests
yarn test
```

WeChat mini-program: use the WeChat Developer Tools to import `dist/dev/mp-weixin`. Before publishing, change the appid in `src/manifest.json` to your own mini-program appid.

## Build

```bash
yarn build:mp-weixin
yarn build:h5
```

## Directory Structure

- `src/pages/tools/index.vue`: Tools page and "All Tools" drawer
- `src/pages/baby/index.vue`: Baby home page
- `src/package-baby/records/index.vue`: Daily records
- `src/package-baby/growth/index.vue`: Growth chart
- `src/package-baby/health/index.vue`: Vaccine reference
- `src/package-baby/journal/index.vue`: Growth journal
- `src/package-baby/settings/index.vue`: Data and settings
- `src/components/baby/*`: Baby module components
- `src/data/*`: Vaccine and reference milestone data
- `src/utils/baby/*`: Baby module pure logic and local storage
- `tests/*.test.js`: Vitest unit tests

## Notes

- Baby profile and records are stored only on the device. No login, no cloud upload, and no location permission is requested.
- Clearing the mini-program cache or uninstalling the mini-program will lose local data. Export a backup regularly from "Data & Settings".

Trojankill/Safe-server-lists-for-bypassi.body:
# 🛡️ VPN Config Security Filter

---

## 🚀 What's new in v6.0

The main change: **every link is now actually parsed**, rather than checked with regexes against the raw string. Percent-encoding is decoded, `&` and `\u0026` are fixed, and parameter synonyms are reduced to one name. Everything that previously passed as "unreadable — therefore fine" is now rejected.

### 🔬 Parsing and normalization

- ✅ **URI parser instead of regex** — vless / vmess / trojan / hysteria2 / ss / tuic are parsed into a structure
- ✅ **Double decoding** — `&amp;`, `\u0026`, `%5Cu0026`, `¬`
- ✅ **Invisible characters** — zero-width, BOM, `\n`, and control chars are stripped before checking
- ✅ **Parameter synonyms** — `allowlnsecure` (with a lowercase L), `skip-cert-verify`, `skip_cert_verify`, `insecure`
- ✅ **Lowercase scheme** — `VLESS://` no longer breaks parsing
- ✅ **Insecure flags** — any value other than an explicit `0/false/no/off` counts as enabled
- ✅ **vmess `"tls":"none"`** — no longer passes as valid TLS
- ✅ **Duplicates before limits** — one node with different names no longer pushes out honest configs

### 🌐 Addresses and protocols

- ✅ **`ipaddress` instead of regex** — 169.254/16, 100.64/10, 198.18/15,…

**[Start Learning](https://learn-ukrainian.github.io)**

A comprehensive Ukrainian language curriculum with 1,778 modules across 22 tracks:

# 露娜笔记 (LonaNote)

[Chinese](https://github.com/luoluoqixi/lonanote/blob/HEAD/README.md) | [English](https://github.com/luoluoqixi/lonanote/blob/HEAD/README_en.md)

A local-first open source note-taking app, written in **TypeScript** and **Rust**.

## 🎉 Introduction

**露娜笔记** is an open source, cross-platform, local-first Markdown note-taking app that supports WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get) editing of Markdown.

Notes are stored **offline, locally** in the open Markdown format, so you can switch to other note-taking apps at any time without importing or exporting.

**Supported platforms**: `Windows`, `MacOS`, `Linux`, `Android`, `iOS`.

## ✨ Key Features

- **Local storage** - Markdown text files are stored entirely locally
- **Raw file system** - no database
- **WYSIWYG editing** - live preview
- **Architecture** - desktop uses Tauri + React Native Web, mobile uses Expo / React Native, core uses Rust

### 📸 Screenshots

#### Desktop (light/dark mode)

#### Mobile (light/dark mode)

### 🎹 Keyboard Shortcuts

**LonaNote** provides the following shortcuts to speed up editing:

`Ctrl+B` - **Bold**

`Ctrl+I` - *Italic*

`Ctrl+D` - ~~Strikethrough~~

`Ctrl+H` - ==Highlight==

### 🔧 Slash Menu

Typing the / character in the editor opens the slash menu, for quickly inserting various Markdown syntax elements.

## 🚀 Installation

- **Windows | Mac | Linux | Android**: [Download from Releases](https://github.com/luoluoqixi/lonanote/releases)
- **iOS**: [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/app/id6752297620)

## ❓ FAQ

- **Mac** shows `lonanote.app已损坏，无法打开， 你应该将它移到废纸篓。` (macOS error: the app is damaged and can't be opened; move it to the Trash.)
  - Because the app is unsigned, you need to run `xattr -c lonanote.app` on first launch to open it.
  - Related link: [Apple Discussions](https://discussions.apple.com/thread/253714860?sortBy=best)

## 🗺 To-Do

LonaNote is under active development; contributions are welcome.

molimao/iota.body:
# IOTA Watch

An open-source, five-language, multi-project monitoring dashboard centered on **IOTA Train at Home**. It supports IOTA, XID / MMM, Quantus, fly.ai, Nosana, Gonka, Akash, io.net, Vast.ai and Golem; each project's inputs, cycles, and data coverage are described separately.

**[Official site](https://iotahome.site) · [My Devices](https://iotahome.site/zh/devices) · [IOTA Lookup](https://iotahome.site/zh/app) · [Network Status](https://iotahome.site/zh/network) · [Blog](https://iotahome.site/zh/blog) · [English](https://iotahome.site/en)**

IOTA Watch is an independent MIT-licensed monitor in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean and Japanese. IOTA Train at Home (Macrocosmos / Bittensor SN9) is the core project, with ten project pages covering training, mining and compute. Tool pages query records; separate tutorials explain identifiers, fields and troubleshooting. Public projects use public identifiers; io.net and Vast.ai require account connections with read credentials. Those two integrations have mocked validation; real-account validation remains pending.

The screenshot shows miner distribution and network capacity; the figures are official data as of when the screenshot was taken.

## Features

- **Multi-device monitoring**: add, name, and view devices by public Miner ID, filtering by contributing, waiting for tasks, needs checking, and pending confirmation.
- **Earnings records**: today, cumulative, paid, pending payment, frozen, and minimum payment amounts; also shows USD valuations with source and timestamp.
- **Training history**: view training tokens, throughput, and cumulative tokens by day, week, or month; missing data is left as gaps.
- **Network visualization**: regional distribution donut chart, miner count rankings, slot occupancy, task progress, and tier overview.

# HanDic: morphological analysis dictionary for contemporary Korean

Japanese README: [README_ja.md](https://github.com/okikirmui/handic/blob/HEAD/README_ja.md)

HanDic (한딕) is a dictionary for analyzing contemporary Korean with the morphological analysis engine [MeCab](https://taku910.github.io/mecab/).
It is built from over 130,000 dictionary entries and more than 14,000 [training data](https://github.com/okikirmui/handic/blob/HEAD/docs/source_list.md) items, centered on written language.

## Quick Start (Python / pip)

With the Python package **`handic`**, you can **start morphological analysis right away without building dictionary files**.

### Installing the package

```bash
pip install handic mecab-python3 jamotools
```

### Morphological analysis example

```python
import handic

text = "우리가 평생 내는 의료비는 어디로 가장 많이 흘러갈까?"

print(handic.pos_tag(text))
print(handic.tokenize_hangul(text, mode="surface"))
print(handic.convert_text_to_hanja_hangul(text))
```

**Output**

```python
[('우리03', 'NP'), ('가11', 'JKS'), ('평생', 'NNG'), ('내다02', 'VV'), ('는03', 'ETM'), ('의료비', 'NNG'), ('는01', 'JX'), ('어디01', 'NP'), ('로06', 'JKB'), ('가장01', 'MAG'), ('많이', 'MAG'), ('흘러가다', 'VV'), ('ㄹ까', 'EF'), ('?', 'SF')]
['우리', '가', '평생', '내', '는', '의료비', '는', '어디', '로', '가장', '많이', '흘러가', 'ㄹ까', '?']
우리가 平生 내는 醫療費는 어디로 가장 많이 흘러갈까?
```

omajili-manbu/Xiaomi_Rodin_Kernel_Enhanc.body:
# Xiaomi Rodin Kernel Enhance

[English](https://github.com/omajili-manbu/Xiaomi_Rodin_Kernel_Enhance/blob/HEAD/README.en.md) | Simplified Chinese

An enhanced kernel for the rodin device, built from Xiaomi's open-sourced [`bsp-rodin-v-oss`](https://github.com/MiCode/Xiaomi_Kernel_OpenSource/tree/bsp-rodin-v-oss) kernel source (AOSP `android15-6.6` GKI / MediaTek), and continuously tracking the latest **6.6 LTS**.

## Features

### Root and Hiding
- Built-in **SukiSU-Ultra** (`drivers/kernelsu`), automatically tracked and merged from upstream stable release tags by CI (see “Automation” below)
- Built-in **SuSFS**, integrated from [`omajili-manbu/susfs4ksu` (`gki-android15-6.6-mod`)](https://github.com/omajili-manbu/susfs4ksu/tree/gki-android15-6.6-mod)
- Capable of hiding suspicious SELinux contexts/rules from apps, tied to the SuSFS AVC log spoofing switch

### Anti-Bricking
- **Baseband-guard (BBG)** LSM: intercepts unauthorized writes to critical partitions/device nodes at the kernel layer (from [vc-teahouse/Baseband-guard](https://github.com/vc-teahouse/Baseband-guard), with the allowlist adjusted for rodin)

### Performance
- Compilation optimizations for Cortex-A725 (clang 19+)
- **ThinLTO** link optimization
- **AutoFDO** link optimization based on real-world runtime scenarios (clang 17+)
- **BBRv3** as the default TCP congestion control, with **fq** as the companion network queue scheduler
- **ZSTD** upgraded to v1.5.7
- Built-in ZRAM, with compression algorithms completed, default LZ4

### Stability Fixes
- Fixes intermittent boot hangs and restores vendor module compatibility
- Backports upstream fixes onto Xiaomi's official kernel

The tuning philosophy is **balancing performance and battery life**. All improvements come from compile-time optimizations, newer kernels, newer algorithms, and bug fixes to Xiaomi's official kernel, with no aggressive adjustments favoring either side.

# SimplePlanePlatform

Desktop installer users, please read the [Desktop usage and troubleshooting guide](https://github.com/zhh293/SimplePlanePlatform/blob/HEAD/docs/桌面端使用说明与故障排查.md) first.

The encryption layer adds `chacha20-poly1305-v2` and `aes-gcm-v2`. They use standard AEAD, authenticated record headers, HKDF-derived keys, and independent stream state. Both ends must select a suite with the same name, and the shared key for v2 must be exactly 32 bytes. The existing `Cipher` SPI and transport framing are preserved. The legacy `chacha20` carries a keystream overlap risk and is kept only as a compatibility implementation for migration. Do not treat it as standard ChaCha20-Poly1305. For configuration, migration boundaries, and test methods, see the [crypto v2 spec](https://github.com/zhh293/SimplePlanePlatform/blob/HEAD/docs/design/crypto-v2.md) and the [validation report](https://github.com/zhh293/SimplePlanePlatform/blob/HEAD/docs/design/crypto-v2-validation.md).

## Desktop: adding nodes and certificates

The Windows and macOS installers include a Java runtime. After installation, you still need to enter the address, port, protocol, encryption method, and key that match the server. For nodes that use a self-signed certificate, also import that node's public certificate.

1. Open 'Proxy Configuration', add a node, and fill in the connection information.
2. For HTTP/3, if 'Certificate server name' is left empty, the current node Host is used. If the certificate is issued to a domain but the connection address is an IP, enter that domain.
3. Click 'Import Certificate' and select the PEM-format public certificate provided by your administrator (`.pem`, `.crt`, or `.cer`). The certificate is copied to the application configuration directory. To use system-trusted certificates, clear the custom certificate.
4. Select 'Use this node' and save, confirm that the runtime node is available, then test a web page. Switching closes the connections to the old node. In TUN mode, adding or removing node addresses requires disconnecting first, then saving.

These entries require a new installer build that includes this feature. Old installers do not update automatically when you pull the source. If you edit the configuration from the file side, fully quit and reopen the desktop app before editing, so the old page does not overwrite your changes when it saves. For full instructions, see the [node certificate guide](https://github.com/zhh293/SimplePlanePlatform/blob/HEAD/desktop/docs/node-certificates.md) and [desktop troubleshooting](https://github.com/zhh293/SimplePlanePlatform/blob/HEAD/docs/桌面端使用说明与故障排查.md).
